This was the longest journey of our lives…
We traveled 30+ hours from Amsterdam to New Zealand across multiple countries, flights, and time zones. From excitement to exhaustion, this journey had everything — long flights, airport struggles, sleepless hours, and finally reaching one of the most beautiful countries in the world
Route:Amsterdam → Shanghai → Australia → Auckland
If you're planning long-haul travel or dreaming of New Zealand, this video shows the REAL experience behind it.
